title: オークスの後に・天使！

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: I was sure I was gonna win, but I just couldn't run the way I wanted. I'm sooo annoyed with myself!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: But my fans didn't seem upset at all. In fact, it's like they never expected me to (water stains and eraser marks) Sorry, I got some sweat on the paper!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: Maybe the problem was that I couldn't pull off a cool enough performance. I've gotta show them some real nifty running next time!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: So before the Shuka Sho, I'm gonna run in the Queen Stakes… Go ahead and get your hopes up for that one!
